# polaris_principal_roles (Data Source)

Lists the principal roles of the realm, including the built-in `service_admin` role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "polaris_principal_roles" "all" {}

output "principal_roles" {
  value = data.polaris_principal_roles.all.names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `names` (List of String) Names of the principal roles, in the order returned by Polaris.
- `roles` (Attributes List) The principal roles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `create_timestamp` (Number) Creation time as a Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds.
- `entity_version` (Number) Version of the principal role object, used for optimistic concurrency control.
- `federated` (Boolean) Whether the principal role is federated, that is managed by an external identity provider.
- `last_update_timestamp` (Number) Last update time as a Unix epoch timestamp in milliseconds.
- `name` (String) The name of the principal role.
- `properties` (Map of String) Key-value metadata attached to the principal role.
